theses.thesis: If AI becomes national-security infrastructure, secure government and enterprise AI platforms can retain scarcity value. PLTR upside target is 158.61 by the 2026-06-18 option expiry if defense AI contracts, government AI policy, or enterprise AI deployment commentary validate the sovereign AI/security leg.
theses.catalyst: defense AI contract, government AI policy, earnings, or enterprise AI deployment commentary inside the June 18 options window
theses.plannedExit: first liquid mark after catalyst or thesis invalidation; otherwise close before expiry week
theses.falsifier: government/enterprise AI demand fails to convert into durable revenue, valuation already embeds the security premium, or option IV/spreads absorb the edge
